name: Restart Explorer
description: Applies pending shell changes without logging out

name: Create a system restore point
description: Do this before applying tweaks the first time

name: Clean temp folders
description: Empties %TEMP%, Windows\Temp and the update cache

name: Repair system files (SFC + DISM)
description: Takes a while - watch the output pane

name: Export all drivers
description: Dump every third-party driver to a folder - do this before a reinstall

name: Snapshot installed apps
description: Writes a winget export you can diff against the catalog later

name: Schedule a monthly re-apply
description: Task that re-runs a preset every 4 weeks, undoing what Windows Update resets
